FN-C4YRQWJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 195
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Susan Dubose
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/04/2024
House Bill 195 as introduced could increase the expenditures of local boards of education and
the State Department of Education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to
implement the changes to sex education curriculum required by this bill.
